description: User asks to be reminded tomorrow at 9am. Sequence verified by driving the real runtime with this exact fixture (tests/test_behavioral.py), not assumed from reading code alone -- an earlier draft assumed the interaction agent's execute() call ends after one LLM round, but InteractionAgentRuntime._run_interaction_loop always issues one more call after any tool round to obtain a no-tool-call response that breaks its own loop (the same pattern ExecutionAgentRuntime.execute uses). Six LLM calls total: interaction (send_message_to_user + send_message_to_agent in one round-trip, per system_prompt.md's 'always let the user know what you're about to do before calling this tool'), interaction's loop-closing call, execution agent's createTrigger round, execution agent's loop-closing call, the interaction agent's handle_agent_message relay (send_message_to_user again, summarizing the execution agent's result), and its loop-closing call.
user_message: Remind me tomorrow at 9am to call the vet.

turns.call_purpose: execute() round 1 -- acknowledge the user, then delegate

arguments.message: On it — I'll get that reminder set for tomorrow at 9am.

arguments.instructions: Create a reminder to call the vet tomorrow at 9am.

turns.call_purpose: execute() round 2 -- no more tool calls, closes the loop
execution agent round 1 -- create the trigger
execution agent round 2 -- no more tool calls, closes the loop
turns.content: I've created a reminder to call the vet tomorrow at 9am.

turns.call_purpose: handle_agent_message() round 1 -- relay the execution agent's result

arguments.message: Done — I'll remind you to call the vet tomorrow at 9am.

turns.call_purpose: handle_agent_message() round 2 -- no more tool calls, closes the loop
